name: STRATA built-in rules — Coal Mines Regulations, 2017

mineContext.applicabilityNote: Rules follow CMR 2017 for underground coal mines. Set degreeOfGassiness (1, 2 or 3) in a site file to enable Reg. 166 methane rules, and verify each rule's location context.

dataQuality.note: Software settings, not safety limits. Set expectedSamplingIntervalSeconds to your sensors' reporting interval; when null it is inferred from the data.

parameters.name: Airway_Temp_C

parameters.name: Thermal_IR_Max_C
parameters.description: Maximum surface temperature from thermal infrared camera

parameters.name: Grahams_Ratio
parameters.description: Graham's ratio: CO formed / O2 absorbed × 100

parameters.name: Trickett_Ratio
parameters.description: Jones and Trickett ratio: (CO2 + 0.75 CO − 0.25 H2) / ΔO2

parameters.name: Explosion_Risk_Index
parameters.description: Application-specific explosion risk index (formula not defined in this repository)

context.note: Applies to any place in the mine.

source.document: Coal Mines Regulations, 2017 (Gazette of India: Extraordinary, Part II Sec. 3(i), G.S.R. 1449(E), 27 Nov 2017)
source.clause: Reg. 153(2)(c) (critical: does not exceed 1.25 in any place); Reg. 169(1)(c)(i) (warning: above 0.8 determinations at ≤24 h intervals); Reg. 169(1)(e) (above 1.25 electric supply cut off)

verification.method: Clause text checked word-for-word in a reproduction of the Gazette pages (ielrc.org/content/e1712.pdf) and an independent copy (indiankanoon.org). DGMS/e-Gazette official copy and later amendments could not be checked.

rules.explanation: Methane above 1.25% anywhere breaches Reg. 153(2)(c) and requires power to be cut off in the district (Reg. 169(1)(e)). Above 0.8% the regulation requires determinations at least every 24 hours.

context.note: Every place where persons are required to work or pass.
